name: 04-courses-upload
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT SELECT COURSES: back, setup step 2 of 2, heading 'What are you taking?', searchable list with labelled checkboxes: CSC 301 Database Systems selected; CSC 305 Software Engineering selected; CSC 307 Operating Systems selected; MTH 301 Numerical Methods unselected. Small course-specific custom icons. Bottom sticky selection summary '3 courses selected', primary 'Let’s go'. RIGHT UPLOAD MATERIAL as full-screen app page with compact header 'Add course material', Course field CSC 301 Database Systems, a selected PDF row 'Normalization.pdf' with 18 pages and 1.2 MB, remove icon, title field 'Lecture 06 — Normalization'. Clear visibility text 'Shared with members of CSC 301' and small helper 'Upload material you have permission to share.' Primary 'Upload PDF', text 'Choose another file'. Small star inspecting a document. No desktop drag-and-drop UI, no locked courses.
